status.current: defeats Sara Bloodlily without Ittou Shura and reaches the semifinals
status.condition: injured by Ittou Rasetsu backlash, Sara's copied Edelweiss, and the final exchange, but remains mobile after emergency treatment
status.stakes: keeps his promise to meet Stella in the final while refusing to sever ties with his father

personality.summary: Gentle and polite, yet stubborn enough to define family and victory on his own terms.

abilities_owned: Uho / stealth footwork application of Nukiachi

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fiancee and promised final opponent; her trust steadies him, and he still aims to meet her in the championship match.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister; he cheers for her third-round match and is devastated when Amane leaves her impaled in the waiting room.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Third-round opponent; he refuses to model unless she beats him, learns her father-related motive, and defeats her while respecting her artistic soul.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Father; initially offered a parent-child severance, but Ikki rejects it and reframes their conflict as an ordinary father-son quarrel.
relationships.byakuya-jounosaki: Second-round opponent; Ikki spends Ittou Rasetsu to beat Byakuya in 0.8 seconds because Byakuya's prediction would catch him by the twenty-third move.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Friend; Ikki asks Alice to style Sara so her outfit will not disrupt their match.
relationships.edelweiss: The real swordswoman whose copied method strengthened Ikki; Sara's painting of her becomes the core obstacle of the third-round battle.

periods.summary: Ikki opens the volume by defeating former finalist Byakuya in a record 0.8 seconds with Ittou Rasetsu, but privately recognizes the win as costly because it spends his daily trump card before the Sara match. In the infirmary he recovers, jokes with Stella, meets his father Itsuki, and is stunned when Itsuki proposes severing their parent-child relationship for the Kurogane family's order. During the shopping interlude Ikki helps handle Sara's clothing problem, rescues a teleporting infant with Stella and Sara, and hears Sara's history with her father's unfinished painting. Her statement that one-sided love of a parent is still valid gives Ikki the answer he needed: he refuses to cut ties with Itsuki and tells him to remain his father despite their opposing paths. In the third round Ikki faces Sara without Ittou Shura, dismantles her necro battalion with footwork, exposes the limits of her copied Edelweiss, then uses a one-sword first-strike advantage and even his skull as a timing shield to cut the phantom. He finally defeats Sara's true soul-image, Mario Rosso, by luring it into Edelweiss's residual vacuum cuts and stabbing Sara while holding Intetsu in his teeth. He reaches the semifinals, only to witness Shizuku's bloody defeat by Amane on the waiting-room feed.

key_events.summary: Uses Ittou Rasetsu to defeat Byakuya in 0.8 seconds but suffers severe backlash.
Receives Itsuki's proposal to sever their parent-child relationship and postpones answering.
Learns why Sara needs him as the model for her father's unfinished painting.
Rejects legal severance and accepts Itsuki as his father despite their irreconcilable ideals.
Defeats Sara's Fantasia Art and reaches the semifinals.
Sees Shizuku impaled in the waiting room and enters the nightmare semifinal setup.
